name: travel-day
note: My day (?view=day). The mock opens its timetable-only state (?scenario=scheduled, as the app is at the sample moment) and then My day: its ?view=day gives way to ?scenario=, so a load script presses the phone bar's My day (it works at every width). Seed: mock:sample-day travel, MockSample\PaperworkSeeder, MockSample\TravelSeeder. The mock's sample weather (the head's chip, the free hours' list, the events' chips) has no counterpart here: there's no forecast for a past day, so those elements aren't paired and the rows after them carry y. A tall viewport keeps the whole river in view on both sides.
